chapters.label: Wembley, 2024
chapters.text: Wembley, 2024, the Champions League final. Real Madrid lead one–nil. Then a Dortmund pass goes astray... Bellingham steals it, Vinícius Júnior is away... two–nil!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Bellingham rolls it into Vinícius's path. See him change gear: one quick touch, and he's clear!

chapters.label: Across the keeper
chapters.text: From behind the goal: he sweeps it across the keeper, into the far corner! Real Madrid win their fifteenth European Cup!

chapters.label: Change your speed
chapters.text: Change your speed! Jog, then burst. Quick feet and a sudden sprint get you past defenders!
